business_summary: SBFC Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in fund-based financing activity in India. The company offers secured loans for micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSME); loans against gold; unsecured personal loans and unsecured business loans; and loan management services. It also operates as a corporate agent of insurance products. It serves entrepreneurs, small business owners, self-employed individuals, salaried and working-class individuals, and other individual customers. SBFC Finance Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. SBFC Finance Limited operates as a subsidiary of SBFC Holdings Pte. Ltd.
